title: Volleyball – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Manage volleyball and run matches
hero.lead: This guide covers the volleyball areas from team setup to reports.

body:
Set up a volleyball team

  1. Open Teams.
  2. Create a team or open Edit.
  3. Select Volleyball under Sport.
  4. Select the correct rule profile.
  5. Check team category, age group, court and net height.
  6. Save the team.

Use the match schedule

  1. Select the volleyball team.
  2. Open Matches → Schedule.
  3. Search or filter by Upcoming, Live or Completed.
  4. Select a match.

Use Create match to open the calendar dialog. Enter the date, venue, home team, away team and competition.

Prepare the line-up and rotation

  1. Open the match.
  2. Open Line-up.
  3. Select the team and player.
  4. Enter the shirt number and role.
  5. Add the player.
  6. Set the starting rotation before the set begins.

Kaderblick checks team size, duplicate shirt numbers, libero limits and rotation rules.

Record the match

  1. Select Start set.
  2. Select the point type.
  3. Select a player when needed.
  4. Award the point to the correct team.
  5. Record time-outs, substitutions and sanctions with the matching actions.
  6. Use Undo last point only to correct an entry. Enter a reason.

Points, service changes, rotation, set score and player statistics update together.

Open reports

  1. Open Matches → Reports.
  2. Select a report.
  3. Set the team, date or competition filters.
  4. Use CSV export when you need the data outside Kaderblick.

Maintain volleyball reference data

This area requires the relevant administration permission.

  1. Open Administration → Volleyball master data.
  2. Select rule profiles, competitions, match types, team categories, age groups, point types, line-up roles or sanctions.
  3. Use search and the status filter.
  4. Open Edit.
  5. Check the values and save.
